BJP trains college governing body heads on corruption, politics

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) organized a training session for presidents of over 450 college governing bodies in West Bengal. The training focused on ensuring regular meetings, conducting audits, and maintaining zero tolerance for corruption. It also covered financial oversight, recruitment processes, student welfare, and avoiding political interference in college administration. The event aimed to address corruption and political involvement in the functioning of these bodies.
